# @olddevs/ui

> Design system: tokens, themes and accessible UI primitives for React. This file is
> the index of the Reference that ships with the package.

The links below are relative and point inside the package: read them from its root,
that is, from `node_modules/@olddevs/ui/`. The Reference there is for exactly the
version you have installed. The documentation site is https://ui.olddevs.ru.

This file is generated by `scripts/llms.mjs` from `docs/`. Edit the pages, not the
index: a mismatch fails `npm run llms:check`.

## Start here

- [`@olddevs/ui` Reference](docs/index.md): This Reference is the contract for developers and AI agents who use the package's public API.
- [Setting up `@olddevs/ui`](docs/getting-started.md): React is the kit's only peer dependency (ADR-0072): the app picks its version, and the app must have exactly one copy of it.
- [How to choose a component](docs/component-selection.md): Choose by the meaning of the action and by the state, not by the shape that is easier to build.
- [General conventions for `@olddevs/ui`](docs/conventions.md): The public API is the runtime exports from `src/index.ts`, the types, the entry points described in the documentation, and `styles.css`.
- [Glossary of `@olddevs/ui`](docs/glossary.md): Kit terms.
- [Accessibility: a mandatory contract](docs/accessibility.md): Accessibility is part of a component's public behavior.
- [Themes, tokens and brands](docs/theming.md): This page answers three questions: how the kit's colors are built, which of them you can override in your own app, and how to set up your own brand.
- [Palette](docs/palette.md): This page shows the kit's color values: which palette primitives (labels aside) are declared and which role each of them is assigned to in each theme.
- [Localization: provider and message catalog](docs/i18n.md): Since 2.0.0 the kit defaults to English and supports other languages.
- [Component catalog](docs/components/index.md): The catalog lists the kit's components by group: each has a link to its page, its exports and a note on what the component is and what it is for.
- [Text chat recipe](docs/recipes/chat.md): The `Recipes/Chat` → `BasicTextChat` story composes `PromptInput`, `ChatMessage` and `ChatTranscript` with existing `Button` and `EmptyState` primitives.

## Rules for AI

- [Glossary of `@olddevs/ui`](docs/glossary.md): Kit terms.

## Actions and feedback

- [Button](docs/components/actions/button.md): `Button` runs an action.
- [Chip](docs/components/actions/chip.md): `Chip` is a compact filter button.
- [SplitButton](docs/components/actions/split-button.md): `SplitButton` is a primary action with a menu button for its variants next to it, as **two separate buttons**.
- [Toolbar](docs/components/actions/toolbar.md): An action bar with the `toolbar` role and a single tab stop: Tab enters it and leaves it, arrow keys move focus inside, `Home` and `End` go to the edges, and returning to the toolbar puts focus on the
- [Toggle, Segmented, ToggleGroup and ButtonGroup](docs/components/actions/toggles.md): Choose the component by what the state means:
- [Alert, Banner, Progress, Spinner, Toaster, toast and StatusBadge](docs/components/actions/feedback.md): Choose by the kind of information:
- [CopyButton and Truncate](docs/components/actions/copy-and-truncate.md): Two small things that get rewritten in every project: copying a value to the clipboard with clear feedback, and truncating text with a tooltip showing the full value.

## Input fields

- [PromptInput](docs/components/inputs/prompt-input.md): `PromptInput` is a controlled message draft on `TextControl`.
- [TextControl](docs/components/inputs/text-control.md): `TextControl` is a base text field or textarea with a shared form shell.
- [RichTextEditor](docs/components/inputs/rich-text-editor.md): `RichTextEditor` is a rich text field built on Tiptap v3 (ProseMirror).
- [Editor extension API](docs/api/editor-extension.md): A map of how a product extends `RichTextEditor` from `@olddevs/ui/editor`, and the stability boundary of this API.
- [NumberInput](docs/components/inputs/number-input.md): `NumberInput` is a controlled numeric field with increment/decrement buttons.
- [Checkbox, CheckboxGroup, Radio and RadioGroup](docs/components/inputs/choice-controls.md): `Checkbox` selects an independent yes/no, `CheckboxGroup` selects several values, `RadioGroup` gives one answer to a shared question.
- [Select](docs/components/inputs/select.md): `Select` picks a value only from the closed list `items`.
- [Combobox](docs/components/inputs/combobox.md): `Combobox` combines free text input with a list of options.
- [TagInput](docs/components/inputs/tag-input.md): `TagInput` is a controlled set of strings.
- [Transfer](docs/components/inputs/transfer.md): `Transfer` is a pair of columns with items moved between them: what can be chosen on the left, what is selected on the right.
- [TreeSelect](docs/components/inputs/tree-select.md): `TreeSelect` is a field that picks a node of a hierarchy: a `TreeView` inside a `Popover`.
- [ColorPicker](docs/components/inputs/color-picker.md): `ColorPicker` picks an arbitrary color: a saturation area, a hue strip, a format field and optional presets.
- [SwatchGroup](docs/components/inputs/swatch-group.md): Picking one value from a closed set, where an option is shown as a **color swatch**, not as text.
- [Rating](docs/components/inputs/rating.md): `Rating` is a star rating.
- [Slider and RangeSlider](docs/components/inputs/slider.md): `Slider` sets one number, `RangeSlider` sets the bounds `[min, max]`.
- [SearchControl](docs/components/inputs/search-control.md): `SearchControl` is a controlled search field on top of `TextControl`: a magnifier, an accessible name, clearing and an optional on-screen keyboard.
- [FileDropzone](docs/components/inputs/file-dropzone.md): `FileDropzone` accepts files through drag-and-drop or a file selection button.
- [UploadQueue](docs/components/inputs/upload-queue.md): An upload manager: what has been sent, what is in progress and what failed.
- [PasswordInput](docs/components/inputs/password-input.md): A password field built on the slots of `TextControl`: a show button in `trailing`, a Caps Lock warning under the field.
- [MaskedInput](docs/components/inputs/masked-input.md): A field with an input mask, built on `TextControl`.
- [PhoneInput](docs/components/inputs/phone-input.md): `MaskedInput` with a phone mask, `inputMode="tel"` and `autocomplete="tel"`.
- [PinInput](docs/components/inputs/pin-input.md): Entry of a verification code: N single-digit fields that report **one string** as the value.
- [InlineEdit](docs/components/inputs/inline-edit.md): Edit a value in place: value button → field → confirmation.
- [Form and FormField](docs/components/inputs/form.md): `Form` standardizes submit and locking during a request, but does not create a validation system.
- [FormLayout and FieldRow](docs/components/inputs/form-layout.md): Form layout: `columns` (1 or 2) and `labels` (`top` or `side`), plus `FieldRow` for a full-width field.

## Date and time

- [Calendar](docs/components/date-time/calendar.md): `Calendar` is a low-level controlled building block for picking a single React Aria `DateValue`.
- [RangeCalendar](docs/components/date-time/range-calendar.md): `RangeCalendar` is a building block for a single continuous React Aria `DateValue` range.
- [DatePicker](docs/components/date-time/date-picker.md): `DatePicker` is a ready-made trigger + popover for a single calendar date.
- [DateRangePicker](docs/components/date-time/date-range-picker.md): `DateRangePicker` is a ready-made range picker: a trigger, `RangeCalendar`, relative presets and a separate clear control.
- [DateTimePicker](docs/components/date-time/date-time-picker.md): `DateTimePicker` is composed of `DatePicker` and `TimePicker`.
- [TimePicker](docs/components/date-time/time-picker.md): `TimePicker` is a time field with a mask and a list of upcoming slots.

## Overlays

- [Dialog, ModalHeader and ModalOverlay](docs/components/overlays/dialog.md): Use `Dialog` for a modal dialog with a known title: it provides modality, an accessible name, a focus trap, a portal and focus return.
- [ConfirmDialog](docs/components/overlays/confirm-dialog.md): `ConfirmDialog` confirms a significant or irreversible action.
- [ShortcutsHelp](docs/components/overlays/shortcuts-help.md): A modal dialog with a list of keyboard shortcuts, built on `Dialog`.
- [Drawer](docs/components/overlays/drawer.md): `Drawer` is a modal panel that slides in from the right, the left or the bottom.
- [Popover](docs/components/overlays/popover.md): `Popover` is a compound primitive for a panel attached to an element.
- [HoverCard](docs/components/overlays/hover-card.md): `HoverCard` is a preview card: when you hover over a name or a link, or focus it from the keyboard, a panel with details pops up next to it.
- [Tooltip and HelpTooltip](docs/components/overlays/tooltip.md): `Tooltip` adds a short explanation to a single element on hover and focus.
- [Menu](docs/components/overlays/menu.md): `Menu` is a compound action menu opened by `MenuTrigger`.
- [ContextMenu](docs/components/overlays/context-menu.md): `ContextMenu` is an action menu for a right click and the context menu key.
- [CommandPalette](docs/components/overlays/command-palette.md): `CommandPalette` is a controlled modal search over the app's actions.

## Table

- [DataTable](docs/components/table/data-table.md): An application-level table with ready-made behavior on top of the low-level `Table`: column visibility and order, density, loading and error states, a table toolbar slot (`toolbar`).
- [TableToolbar and TablePreferences](docs/components/table/toolbar.md): `TableToolbar` is the table toolbar: a title, a counter, actions, a filters slot and a preferences slot.
- [FilterBar and FilterBarAdd](docs/components/table/filter-bar.md): `FilterBar` shows the applied filters as removable tags; `FilterBarAdd` is an add button with a choice of field and value, or of range bounds (amount, date).
- [SavedViews](docs/components/table/saved-views.md): `SavedViews` is a switcher of named state snapshots.

## App shell

- [AppShell](docs/components/app-shell/app-shell.md): The application shell: navigation on the left, a header on top, content in `<main>`, an optional right area and a bottom bar.
- [SideNav, NavGroup and NavItem](docs/components/app-shell/side-nav.md): `SideNav` is the application's side navigation: a named landmark, header and footer slots, and `NavGroup` sections with `NavItem` items.
- [MobileTabBar and MobileTabBarItem](docs/components/app-shell/mobile-tab-bar.md): `MobileTabBar` is the bottom bar of main sections for a phone: a named `<nav>` (the default comes from the message catalog) with `MobileTabBarItem` items in a row, equal in width.
- [TopBar](docs/components/app-shell/top-bar.md): The application header: brand, search and action slots, sticky positioning, a translucent background on a theme token.
- [SplitPanel](docs/components/app-shell/split-panel.md): `SplitPanel` lays out two areas separated by a resizable boundary: the content and a details panel.

## Navigation

- [Tabs](docs/components/navigation/tabs.md): `Tabs` is a controlled-only tab strip; the component renders only the tablist, not the panels.
- [Accordion](docs/components/navigation/accordion.md): `Accordion` is a set of expandable sections built on react-aria.
- [Breadcrumbs](docs/components/navigation/breadcrumbs.md): `Breadcrumbs` shows the path to the current page.
- [Pagination](docs/components/navigation/pagination.md): `Pagination` is controlled pagination for a collection that is already split into pages.
- [Stepper](docs/components/navigation/stepper.md): `Stepper` shows the order of a wizard's steps; the parent sets the current index (controlled).
- [MegaMenu](docs/components/navigation/mega-menu.md): `MegaMenu` is an Amazon-style store catalog: a category column on the left and, next to the hovered category, its flyout with columns of links and any content of your own.
- [TreeView](docs/components/navigation/tree-view.md): A hierarchy with expansion, selection and keyboard support, built on react-aria's `Tree`.
- [SelectionBar and useStickyOffset](docs/components/navigation/selection-bar.md): `SelectionBar` is a batch action bar: "12 selected" and what can be done with them.
- [ContextualSaveBar](docs/components/navigation/contextual-save-bar.md): A bar for unsaved changes: it appears with the first edit of a form, shows "there are unsaved changes" (or their count) and two buttons — save and cancel.
- [PageHeader](docs/components/navigation/page-header.md): `PageHeader` is the single page header with an `h1`, an optional description and action nodes.
- [SectionHeader](docs/components/navigation/section-header.md): `SectionHeader` is a heading inside a section or card: the title on the left, an auxiliary `right` node on the right.

## Content

- [ChatMessage](docs/components/content/chat-message.md): `ChatMessage` presents one message as an article with author, optional time, input method, presentation state, body and actions.
- [ChatTranscript](docs/components/content/chat-transcript.md): `ChatTranscript` is a named scrollable reading viewport.
- [Typography: `Text`, `Heading`, `Link`](docs/components/content/typography.md): Use `Heading` for document structure, `Text` for paragraphs and auxiliary lines, `Link` for navigation.
- [Card](docs/components/content/card.md): `Card` is a visual panel with a background, border, shadow, inner padding and rounded corners.
- [Image](docs/components/content/image.md): `Image` handles all three states of a picture: loading, loaded and failed to load.
- [Timeline](docs/components/content/timeline.md): `Timeline` is a list of process steps: what has already happened and how it ended.
- [CodeView](docs/components/content/code-view.md): `CodeView` is a code viewer: a JSON API response, a YAML config, a webhook body.
- [NotificationItem, NotificationList and NotificationCenter](docs/components/content/notifications.md): A list of events: what happened, when, and whether it has been read.
- [MediaCard](docs/components/content/media-card.md): An image tile: a preview in a set aspect ratio, actions over it, badges and selection.
- [SortableList](docs/components/content/sortable-list.md): A list whose order the user sets by dragging.
- [EditableList](docs/components/content/editable-list.md): A list in which rows are edited in place and reordered by dragging, and new ones are added at the bottom.
- [RichTextView](docs/components/content/rich-text-view.md): `RichTextView` shows the saved HTML of `RichTextEditor` with the same typography as inside the Editor.
- [RichTextToc](docs/components/content/rich-text-toc.md): `RichTextToc` is the Table of contents of a Document, placed next to the View (`RichTextView`) or an Editor in `readOnly`.
- [VirtualGrid](docs/components/content/virtual-grid.md): A virtualized card grid: the visible cells and a small overscan around them live in the DOM.
- [Avatar and AvatarGroup](docs/components/content/avatar.md): `Avatar` shows a photo from `src` or, if there is none or it failed to load, initials and a stable gradient computed from the name.
- [Data display: `Badge`, `Stat`, `DescriptionList`, `Table`](docs/components/content/data-display.md): Choose the component by the shape and meaning of the data: `Badge` answers "how many" or "is there anything new", `Stat` is for a single metric with context, `DescriptionList` for "property — value" p
- [EmptyState, ErrorState and Skeleton](docs/components/content/empty-and-loading.md): Three screen states that have no content, and they are not interchangeable: Show `Skeleton` while the result is not known yet, `EmptyState` when the request succeeded and returned nothing, and `ErrorS
- [Layout primitives: `Separator`, `ScrollArea`, `AspectRatio`, `Kbd`](docs/components/content/layout-primitives.md): These are low-level building blocks, not a full layout system.
- [Grid](docs/components/content/grid.md): A responsive grid of equal columns built on Tailwind utilities.
- [TagGroup and Tag](docs/components/content/tag-group.md): A set of tags **for display**: post categories, projects, labels.
- [Carousel](docs/components/content/carousel.md): A strip of slides on native scrolling with CSS scroll-snap: the "previous" and "next" buttons, the mouse wheel, the trackpad, swipe and the arrow keys all move it; after a gesture the slide settles ex
- [Keyboard and VisuallyHidden](docs/components/content/keyboard.md): `Keyboard` is a controlled on-screen keyboard for an existing text field: it edits the string and the selection through handlers, and does not receive the field's DOM ref.
- [Icons `@olddevs/ui/icons`](docs/icons.md): Import icons only from `@olddevs/ui/icons`, choosing the name by the meaning of the action or entity: `DeleteIcon`, not a shape such as `Trash`.
- [Shared API: utilities, tokens, constants and types](docs/api/utilities.md): `@olddevs/ui` exports several programmatic APIs besides components.
